activity.notes: Pyrrhus is normalized to Epirus, his primary kingdom, rather than generic Greece or Macedon. ATLAS records his main adult Epirote reign, 297–272 BCE; his earlier interrupted minority reign and separate Macedonian kingship are intentionally not expanded into extra Activities here.

sources.title: Pyrrhus of Epirus - Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford Classical Dictionary identifies Pyrrhus as the leading Molossian king of Epirus, records an earlier interrupted minority reign, later restoration, and death in 272 BCE.

sources.title: Dione - Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford Classical Dictionary dates an Epirote tetradrachm of Pyrrhus to c.297 BCE, supporting the conventional start of his restored adult kingship.
